result.description:
VeiraMal Consulting is seeking an experienced Electrical Engineering Technician to join our clients' business CEEPRO in Campbellfield. Our client is looking for an enthusiastic individual who can work well in a team, with strong communication skills.
Objective of The Position: 	 

- To provide technical support in the design, installation, testing, and maintenance of electrical systems.
- To assist engineers in ensuring safe, accurate, and efficient operation of electrical installations and components.


Responsible for:	

Assisting in the execution and maintenance of electrical works and systems, supporting engineering staff with technical and operational tasks.

Accountable to: Manager / Director

Performance appraisal: 

Three months after appointment, then at least annually and/or when required.

Job Descriptions: 

- Design and install electrical systems in caravans, including 12V and 240V AC circuits, ensuring efficient power distribution 
- Diagnose and repair electrical faults in caravans including wiring, batteries, inverters and converters 
- Conduct inspections of electrical installations to ensure compliance with safety standard and mobile unit regulations
- Install, maintain and repair solar power systems to provide a sustainable energy source of caravans 
- Install and maintain inverters and convertors to manage the conversion of DC to AC power and vice versa in caravans 
- Perform routine maintenance and upgrade to caravan electrical systems to ensure optimal performance and safety 
- Collect data, perform tests and document electrical system performance through charts and calculations 
- Estimate materials and costs for electrical installations, ensuring efficient resource use within budget 
- Assemble, test and install electrical equipment following industry safety standards and regulations 

Requirements:

- Prior hands-on experience in an electrical technician or trade support role.
- Familiarity with electrical tools, diagnostic equipment, and maintenance practices.
- Strong ability to follow engineering instructions and technical procedures.
- Good communication and teamwork skills.
- Committed to maintaining safety, compliance, and technical accuracy.

Qualifications/experience:	

- Diploma or trade qualification in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
- Relevant experience in electrical systems, equipment assembly, or maintenance.
- Knowledge of safety protocols and electrical regulations.
- Strong attention to detail and good problem-solving skills.
- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and specifications.

Remuneration: $75,000.00 - $85,000.00 + Super

Location: 10 Production Dr, Campbellfield VIC 3061

If you are interested and think you will be a good fit for this role, please apply.
result.title: Electrical Engineering Technician

The Australian Automotive Group (AAG)
  
  
Position  : Full Time
Salar y    : $75,000 - $85,000 a year
Location : Sydney
  
  
The Australian Automotive Group (AAG) has evolved into an outstanding portfolio of automotive assets. The core of which is the six leading Ford dealerships in Sydney. The Ford portfolio has been complemented by the addition of Suzuki, Renault, Mitsubishi, Hyundai, Isuzu and Kia.
  
Australian Automotive Group is currently looking for experienced, motivated, and enthusiastic for ICT Support Technician to join their head office in Alexandria NSW.

Their dealerships in Sydney are: Brad Garlick Ford, Castle Hill Renault, City Ford Sydney, City Ford Rockdale, Cumberland Ford, Cumberland Suzuki, Power Ford, Titan Ford, Brookvale Mitsubishi, Ryde Hyundai, Castle Hill Isuzu Ute, Ryde Isuzu Ute, and Rockdale City Kia.
  
The role will involve the following:
Provide technical support to employees via phone, email, remote access, or onsite.
Install, configure, and maintain desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, mobile devices, and other IT equipment.
Troubleshoot hardware, software, network, and connectivity issues.
Set up and manage user accounts, passwords, email accounts, and access permissions
Install, configure, and update operating systems and business applications.
Support dealership management systems
Maintain Microsoft 365 services, including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint.
Monitor and maintain LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, internet connectivity, and network devices.
Assist with cybersecurity by applying software updates, antivirus protection, and security policies.
Assist with server maintenance, backup verification, and disaster recovery procedures.
Document IT procedures, troubleshooting guides, and system configurations.
Ensure compliance with company IT policies, cybersecurity standards, and data privacy requirements.
  
The successful candidate will need the following:
Minimum 2 years’ relevant experience
Relevant qualification
Strong knowledge and troubleshooting of Microsoft Windows and Service OS
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Entra ID and Azure knowledge is highly regarded
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong customer service focus with the ability to support users of varying technical abilities.
Good organisational skills with the ability to prioritise multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.
High attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate documentation.

result.description:
Diesel Motor Mechanic
Coath Rd, West Kalgoorlie WA 6430
Ful-time

Our client, VPT Mechanical Solutions, is seeking experienced Diesel Motor Mechanics to join their growing team in West Kalgoorlie, Western Australia. As part of the VPT Group, a leading Western Australian industrial services company supporting mining and resource operations, they deliver mechanical, fire suppression, and drilling support services with a strong focus on safety, reliability, quality, and operational excellence.

This is an excellent opportunity for qualified Diesel Motor Mechanics who are looking to build a long-term career within a supportive and professional environment.

Key Responsibilities

* Diagnose and rectify mechanical and electrical faults in diesel engines, heavy vehicles, and mobile equipment.
* Dismantle, inspect, repair, and reassemble engines, transmissions, steering systems, suspension, braking systems, and other mechanical components.
* Replace worn or defective parts in accordance with manufacturer specifications and service manuals.
* Perform routine servicing and preventative maintenance, including oil changes, lubrication, engine tune-ups, and scheduled inspections.
* Test and adjust repaired components to ensure safe and efficient operation.
* Use computer-based diagnostic equipment to identify faults and assess engine performance.
* Inspect vehicles and equipment for roadworthiness and compliance, recommending repairs where required.
* Attend breakdowns and provide on-site mechanical support when necessary.

About us
We are a Brisbane-based leader in laboratory products and services. We hold NATA accreditation in Controlled Environments — testing and certifying biosafety cabinets, laminar flow units, fume cupboards, HEPA filters and cleanrooms for hospitals, universities, research institutes and government facilities across Queensland.

The role — and the deal
This is a hands-on, field-based job, and we train you from the ground up. You’ll travel to client sites around Brisbane (occasionally regional QLD) to test, certify, service and repair specialist lab equipment — biosafety cabinets, fume cupboards, centrifuges, incubators, ultra-low-temperature freezers, particle counters and more.

You don’t need to have done this before. If you’ve got a solid technical trade and the right attitude, we’ll teach you our NATA-accredited methods and put you through the certifications. You walk away building a portable, in-demand NATA qualification and a long-term career in a specialised field.

Who we’re after
A background in one of: electrical, instrumentation, HVAC / refrigeration, biomedical, or a related technical trade. More importantly, someone who:
•Follows through and gets the job done without being chased

About the business and the role  

You will be working for a national safety wholesaler with a Perth Head Office. You will be working from your own home office.
Ideally, you are located in Brisbane metro area.

Your role will be to 
1. Manage an existing wholesale client list;
2. Grow the client base with new clients; and
3. Cross selling products to the existing customers. 

The role is an autonomous role, reporting directly to the directors of the company based Perth. 

The business is a family owned company and has been in operation since 1980. The company imports and wholesales consumable safety products including hard hats, gloves, glasses, respirators, and much more. 

The fast changing pace of the industry ensures you are always challenged with different ideas and helping clients solve problems. 

The industry has many standards and we can help you improve your technical knowledge with our in-house training program. 

Job tasks and responsibilities  
The QLD/TAS Account Manager is responsible for servicing key regions including all of Queensland, NSW Northern Rivers. The area also includes all of Tasmania. Due to current structure, the role includes servicing a segment of Victoria.

The role provides great opportunity for travel throughout the key regions. 

You are responsible for planning your call cycles and regional travels to ensure clients are kept up to date with the latest developments. You will work closely with your interstate counterparts in NSW and WA.

In working with the customers, you may be required to undertake joint calls with your customer to visit the end users. 

You are required to report on sales actuals compared to budget on a monthly basis as well as prepare weekly call reports, and update Master Run Sheets.

The role requires you to participate in trade shows/events. 

Skills and experience  
An industrial and safety background is ideal but not mandatory. 

You must have a car to perform this role. 

Competent computer skills are important including being proficient at using Word, Excel, Outlook and Internet. 

A business to business sales call background is ideal. 

This role is open only to Australian Residents/Citizens. 

Successful candidates will be contacted for a phone interview and thereafter a video call and or a face to face interview.

Job benefits and perks  
A salary and motor vehicle allowance is provided. 
Mobile phone with calls and data is covered.
